sentences.text:
Dasarath Devi Dubey & Ors vs Unknown on 29 December, 2025
29.12.2025
Ct.No.6
Dl.58
Sb/Milan
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 Crr 5611 of 2025

In Re:- An application under Section 482 read with
Section 401 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
 corresponding to Section 528 read with Section 442 of the
 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 filed on
 24.12.2025.

And
 In the matter of : Dasarath Devi Dubey & Ors.
 ...Petitioners.
 Mr. Kusal Kumar Mukherjee,
 Mr. K.K. Tiwary,
 Mr. Sayan Das
 ...

The present revisional application has been preferred challenging the order dated 27.11.2025 passed by the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate -II, Calcutta, in connection with G.R. Case No.1069/2020 also GRNS/1069/2020 which is arising out of Amherst Street Police Station Case No.254 of 2020 dated 18.11.2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, thereby rejecting the prayer of the discharge petition of the present petitioners, now pending before the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate -II, Calcutta.
2. The instant revisional application is required to be heard.

3. The petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the instant revisional application upon the opposite party no.1 through the Office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no.2 by registered speed post with acknowledgment due card and file affidavit of service on the date fixed for hearing.
4. List the instant revisional application before the regular Bench in Combined Monthly List of February, 2026 subject to convenience of that Bench under the heading "Contested Application".

sentences.text: Pending hearing of the instant revisional application the order dated 27.11.2025 passed by the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate -II, Calcutta, in connection with G.R. Case No.1069/2020 also GRNS/1069/2020, arising out of Amherst Street Police Station Case No.254 of 2020 dated 18.11.2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, thereby rejecting the prayer of discharge of the present petitioners and the proceedings connected thereto, now pending before the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate -II, Calcutta be stayed till 27th February, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.

6. Liberty to pray for extension, modification, variation and/or vacating of the interim order upon notice to the other side.
7.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties upon compliance of all necessary formalities.

(Shampa Dutt (Paul) J.)
